scope: Actual pinned ELF32/ELF64 module symbol normalization and field encoding

verification.targeted_tests: All eleven linux::module_elf tests passed, including all symbol byte comparisons and ELF32 overflow failures.

limitations: Synthetic symbol objects execute the actual pinned _fix_sym_table method; they do not establish real image discovery or full module extraction parity.
ELF32 encoder output is tested, but the production full-file reconstruction still accepts only 64-bit Intel symbols.

The native shared encoder preserves zero-name LOCAL/SECTION info, relative section values, external indices and checked 32-bit value/size conversions. Reference struct.error maps to native Result::Err.
No full plugin contract is established by this fixture.
